message: Read submit/review/done/context code and workflow.CheckApprovedDone; tests pass (TestNoSelfReview, TestAgentsCloseWithApproval, TestBoardGroupsByStatus). Scratch e2e: agent submit->agent_review, reject->in_progress, done refused w/o approver and allowed with, human submit->review, context section. Self-review follow-up now resolved by T-0062; review-ticket migration is a deliberate no-op. Board/picker visuals only checked via board_test order.

check/check add --manual/--how and new --manual-check present (internal/cli/sections.go, commands.go); agents refused tick/waive; TestManualChecks/TestNewManualCheck/TestReviewWarningsSeparateManual pass; shp show renders ✋ and how. Gaps: no unit test for render.Markdown ✋/how output, and 'check add' saves without a journal event. Hand check 4 (TUI preview) left for human.

review.Spawn strips author env, sets agent:reviewer + own session, detached with pid/log; autoReview on agent submit when reviewer.auto; --spawn; selfReview guard by session. TestSpawn, TestSubmitLaunchesReviewer, TestNoSelfReview pass; self-review refusal confirmed in scratch repo. Waiver of Stop-hook check is justified but description still says Stop hook. Real claude -p run and enabling reviewer in this repo's config are for a human.

internal/policy: missing file = no auto-done, catch-all and nameless rules refused, labels/under/max_lines, unresolved or manual checks block. TestCloses/TestPolicyClosesOnPass pass. Check 3 has no test asserting approved_by, so verified in a scratch repo: journal approved_by=policy:low, worklog 'closed by policy:low', shp policy <id> explains. No policy.yaml in this repo (follow-up).

inbox.go: n toggles board filtered to review+agent_review, ✋ first, header count, a approves (ticks ✋ checks, journaled), x sends back with required note; agents' approve refused. TestInbox* (4) pass. Check 2 text says 'r rejects' but the key is x; fix the wording. Hand check 4 (feel in real TUI) left for human.
